intro: Scanning. Meat, cloth, fear. Nothing of value.
You came for the iron. The iron came for you.
My sensors know you now. You are already on my list.
Welcome to the breakdown line. You are raw material.
Recording this fight. Your ending goes to the archive.
The limb collector. At last. I have been waiting.
You breathe loudly. My sensors can hear it.
phase2: Armor shed. Switching to the second protocol.
You cracked the hull. Threat level raised.
Recalculating tactics. Your window is closing.
Reserve circuits online. Let us continue.
The first layer is gone. The steel beneath is thicker.
An error in my calculations. Correcting. Now.
You have earned phase two. You will not enjoy it.
phase3_enrage: Limiters off. There are no protocols anymore.
Overheating. I no longer care. You should.
Core in the red. I will take you with me.
Last circuit. I will become your grave.
Rage is not an emotion. It is a mode. It is on.
You pushed me this far. Now I push back.
player_hiding: Hiding? My sensors see heat. You are a candle.
Silence will not save you. I hear your pulse.
Corners are finite. My sensors are not.
You smell of gunpowder. The trail leads to you.
Hide your breathing. I have found the rest.
Thermal contact: three meters right. Coming.
Meat in cover is still meat. Just boxed.
You blink. I do not. I will find you first.
Hide-and-seek is not in my protocol. Come out.
player_camping: Standing still? That makes aiming easier.
You have grown roots. I am good at uprooting.
One position - one mistake. Your last one.
Coordinates locked. You are not moving.
Your position is committed to memory. Forever.
Dug in? Then I will bring the collapse.
player_rushing: Running at me? Logic damaged. Like you.
Brave. Stupid. The difference shows in the autopsy.
Come closer. I have a use for your arms.
You are in my zone. Counting down from one.
A frontal attack. Logged as suicide.
player_low_hp: Your readings are dropping. I hear it in your steps.
Blood is poor coolant. You have a leak.
Organism resource near zero. Finishing up.
You are held together by willpower. I break that too.
A little more. Your chassis does not self-repair.
Save the bandages. They do not stop a protocol.
Red zone. Machines repair. You do not.
player_downed: The downed do not run. Energy saved.
Crawl. I want to see how far you get.
Your friends will be late. I calculated everything.
Reassemble yourself, scavenger. Or stay down there.
One down. Proceeding through the list.
I hear you calling. Only I can hear you.
boss_hit_weakpoint: You found a node. It will not stay open.
Critical damage. You are learning. So am I.
That plate will close. Yours will not.
There was a weak point. Key word - was.
You aim at my schematics. I rewrite schematics.
Excellent shot. There will not be a second.
boss_healthy_taunt: My hull is intact. Yours is temporary.
You are shooting armor. Armor does not count them.
Keep going. I am gathering statistics.
Your ammo will run out before my patience.
Your tactics are predictable. Computing all branches.
Metal does not tire. Meat always does.
I know no fear. You are its source.
Every shot you fire is a line in my report.
You are fighting a factory. The factory does not end.
How many limbs will you steal before the finale?
Your weapon is scrap. Mine is engineering.
minion_died: You broke one unit. I have a warehouse.
It was expendable. So are you.
Minus one chassis. Minus zero threat.
You dismantle mine. I will dismantle you.
Their wreckage will pile on top of yours.
Thanks for the scrap metal. I will recycle it later.
player_skill_used: A stolen limb in combat. Looted iron.
You use our schematics. Against us.
That ability was ours. I am taking it back.
You wear dead machines. I hear their protocol.
Stolen power. The warranty is void.
Implants made of scrap. They fail first.
player_wall_break: You break concrete. I break what hides behind it.
Destruction logged. The invoice is coming.
The walls were never yours. Neither is this sector.
That collapse was heard two blocks away. Thank you.
Keep breaking. There will be less cover.
You are opening a firing line. For you and for me.
The dust settled. Your silhouette did not.
nemesis_return: %s is back. It has studied you.
You ran from %s once. Not again.
We rebuilt %s. Improved it. For you.
%s does not forget. That is its protocol.
Hear that grinding? %s is coming to collect.
Your old acquaintance %s is back online.
%s has adapted. Your old trick is dead.
Hunter %s in position. Run, if you believe in that.
nemesis_killed_you_before: %s has dropped you before. Remember the dust?
You died to %s once. Repeating per protocol.
%s knows the taste of your blood on its plating.
%s will finish what it started last time.
You did not learn %s's lesson. Repeating it louder.
boss_dying: Critical failure. But the data already left.
You broke the hull. The network will remember me.
I am not the last. I am only the first report.
My schematics will spread to every machine.
Shutting down. Your profile is already uploaded.
Take my limbs. They will remember you.
A machine's death is an update. Prepare.
Core fading. Your name is already in the archive.
You won the round. The factory wins the war.
boss_defeated_you: Out of meat. Returning to patrol.
Your loot is mine now. Breakdown complete.
You were a statistic. Now you are a line item.
storm: The storm is here. It is on my side.
The storm jams your comms. Not mine.
Storm. Every machine is converging on your signal.
Weather is a protocol too. And it is mine.
The wind carries iron. Straight to you.
Evac is closing. So is your window.
No one will find you in the storm. Except me.
generic_combat: Keep moving. I need the practice.
Your pulse is my crosshair.
Counting the rounds in your magazine. Few left.
Every step you take is a step toward me.
Dodge. I will correct the trajectory.
Meat, cloth, bone. All predictable.
You fight a calculation. The calculation wins.
Your armor is foil. My hull is plate.
Retreat. Beyond this, everything is my sector.
I see you in three spectrums at once.
You are tired. I hear it in your tempo.
A mistake. Another. Soon the last one.
Do not holster the weapon. It will not save you anyway.
Your team is far away. Sensor-verified.
Metal versus meat. The outcome is known.
A little more data and I will know all of you.
Your sprints are adding up to a pattern.
I am not in a hurry. My charge is infinite.
Dust, blood, scrap. A standard report.
You are temporary. I am serial.
Reload. I will wait. Briefly.
I hear footsteps. Heavy ones. Carrying loot.
Your body is poor engineering. Too soft.
Surrender or run. Same result.
